text:
emily: quick heads-up — onboarding orenda-v1 int8 into staging; small smoke shows locale regressions we should triage.

ran: what kind of regressions?

emily: two reproducible failure modes on int8: (1) ja->en polite prompts lose honorific nuance (keigo signals weakened). (2) ar/en mixed lines sometimes flip parentheses and drop trailing punctuation.

kai: only on int8? which kernels/profiles?

emily: yes, only int8 with matmul-v3 + fused-softmax. fp32 and q4 candidates look OK.

marco: metrics?

emily: short-run numbers from onboard smoke subset:

```
fp32: BLEU=32.0, COMET=0.48
int8 (v3): BLEU=27.2, COMET=0.17
delta: BLEU -4.8, COMET -0.31
```

emily: minimal example ja source: "\u5148\u751f\u306b\u3057\u3066\u305f\u3060\u304f\u3053\u3068\u304c\u3042\u308a\u307e\u3059\u304b\u3002"
emily: fp32 -> "Would you please do this, professor? (polite)"
emily: int8 -> "Do this, professor?"  <-- politeness lost

ran: token traces?

emily: found extra 0 token insertion in raw ids on mixed-dir contexts. snippet:

```
fp32 ids: [6123, 9, 4201, 310]
int8 ids: [6123, 9, 0, 4201, 310]
```

emily: in arabic-paren case the 0 causes detok+bidi to reorder: "(API)" -> ")API(" and sometimes the trailing ? is gone.

kai: that suggests either quantized sampling or a stray zero in the output buffer. i'll run svmap+asan on matmul-v3 with mixed-dir inputs and trace token sampling. ETA ~3h.

marco: short-term mitigation: add a detok sanitizer to drop NUL/0 tokens before unicode-bidi and add two smoke checks to model-onboard: ja-keigo-preserve and ar-paren-preserve. block int8 candidate if they fail.

ci-bot: staging-int8-orenda-v1 rollout paused until locale-smoke passes (pipeline: locale-onboard-5581).

runtime-bot: opened issue ML-1983 with samples, traces, and metric diffs. link: https://redwood-internal/p/ML-1983

emily: thanks — i'll attach the failing inputs and keep this thread updated once kai posts kernel traces. :pray:
